stem: After a football match in Jaipur, Rohan is breathing fast. His teacher explains two processes happening in his body. Which statement correctly describes breathing and respiration?

options.text: Breathing is a chemical process, and respiration is a physical process of taking in air.
Breathing is the physical process of inhaling and exhaling air, while respiration is a chemical process in which food substances are broken down with oxygen to release energy inside the body.
Breathing and respiration are two names for exactly the same process.
Respiration is a physical process because no new substance can be seen forming inside the body.

teacher.key_rationale: Breathing is the physical movement of air in and out of the lungs; respiration is the chemical breakdown of food substances with oxygen to release energy. Only option B states both correctly. Option A reverses the two processes, option C claims they are identical, and option D misclassifies respiration as physical on the basis of surface appearance.
